mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE visible_scope(organization_unit_id,include_descendants) AS (SELECT scope_target_id,include_descendants FROM seal.user_scope WHERE admin_user_id=#{actorId} AND scope_type='ORGANIZATION' AND active=TRUE UNION SELECT c.organization_unit_id,TRUE FROM seal.organization_unit c JOIN visible_scope p ON c.parent_id=p.organization_unit_id WHERE p.include_descendants=TRUE)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seal.retention_job(retention_job_id,consent_request_id,recipient_id,retention_policy_version_id,source_rights_request_id,anchor_date,due_date,job_status,destruction_method,requested_by,requested_at) SELECT #{id},r.consent_request_id,r.recipient_id,r.retention_policy_version_id,rr.rights_request_id,CURRENT_DATE,CURRENT_DATE,'PENDING_APPROVAL',p.destruction_method,#{actorId},#{now} FROM seal.consent_request r JOIN seal.retention_policy_version p USING(retention_policy_version_id) JOIN visible_scope s USING(organization_unit_id) JOIN seal.rights_request rr ON rr.rights_request_id=#{rights} AND rr.consent_request_id=r.consent_request_id AND rr.recipient_id=r.recipient_id AND rr.organization_unit_id=r.organization_unit_id WHERE r.consent_request_id=#{request} AND r.recipient_id=#{recipient} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM seal.retention_job j WHERE j.consent_request_id=r.consent_request_id AND j.job_status NOT IN('CONFIRMED','CANCELLED'))
mapper.select: SELECT j.retention_job_id FROM seal.retention_job j JOIN seal.consent_request r USING(consent_request_id) JOIN visible_scope s USING(organization_unit_id) WHERE j.consent_request_id=#{request} AND j.job_status NOT IN('CONFIRMED','CANCELLED') ORDER BY j.requested_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: WITH base AS (SELECT r.consent_request_id,r.recipient_id,r.retention_policy_version_id,p.destruction_method,p.period_value,p.period_unit,p.grace_period_days,CASE p.start_event WHEN 'CONSENT_SUBMITTED_AT' THEN res.submitted_at::date WHEN 'REQUEST_COMPLETED_AT' THEN COALESCE(r.completed_at,res.submitted_at)::date WHEN 'PROGRAM_END_AT' THEN (SELECT anchor_date FROM seal.retention_anchor_event a WHERE a.consent_request_id=r.consent_request_id AND a.anchor_type='PROGRAM_END_AT' AND a.active LIMIT 1) WHEN 'PURPOSE_ACHIEVED_AT' THEN (SELECT anchor_date FROM seal.retention_anchor_event a WHERE a.consent_request_id=r.consent_request_id AND a.anchor_type='PURPOSE_ACHIEVED_AT' AND a.active LIMIT 1) END anchor_date FROM seal.consent_request r JOIN seal.consent_response res USING(consent_request_id) JOIN seal.retention_policy_version p USING(retention_policy_version_id) WHERE r.request_status='COMPLETED' AND p.workflow_status IN('APPROVED','SUPERSEDED')), due AS (SELECT *,(CASE period_unit WHEN 'DAY' THEN anchor_date+period_value WHEN 'MONTH' THEN (anchor_date+make_interval(months=>period_value))::date WHEN 'YEAR' THEN (anchor_date+make_interval(years=>period_value))::date END)+grace_period_days due_date FROM base WHERE anchor_date IS NOT NULL) INSERT INTO seal.retention_job(retention_job_id,consent_request_id,recipient_id,retention_policy_version_id,anchor_date,due_date,job_status,destruction_method,requested_at) SELECT gen_random_uuid(),d.consent_request_id,d.recipient_id,d.retention_policy_version_id,d.anchor_date,d.due_date,'DUE',d.destruction_method,#{now} FROM due d WHERE d.due_date<=#{today} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM seal.retention_job j WHERE j.consent_request_id=d.consent_request_id AND j.job_status NOT IN('CONFIRMED','CANCELLED'))
mapper.select: SELECT j.retention_job_id id,j.consent_request_id,j.job_status status,j.due_date,j.destruction_method,j.requested_at FROM seal.retention_job j JOIN seal.consent_request r USING(consent_request_id) JOIN visible_scope s USING(organization_unit_id) j.job_status=#{status} ORDER BY j.requested_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT j.* FROM seal.retention_job j JOIN seal.consent_request r USING(consent_request_id) JOIN visible_scope s USING(organization_unit_id) WHERE j.retention_job_id=#{id}
SELECT j.* FROM seal.retention_job j JOIN seal.consent_request r USING(consent_request_id) JOIN visible_scope s USING(organization_unit_id) WHERE j.retention_job_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE OF j
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM seal.legal_hold WHERE consent_request_id=#{request} AND active AND (expires_on IS NULL OR expires_on>=#{today}))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seal.legal_hold(legal_hold_id,consent_request_id,hold_reason_code,reason_text,active,held_by,held_at) SELECT #{id},r.consent_request_id,'RIGHTS_RESTRICTION','정보주체 처리제한 권리요청',TRUE,#{actorId},#{now} FROM seal.consent_request r JOIN visible_scope s USING(organization_unit_id) WHERE r.consent_request_id=#{request} ON CONFLICT (consent_request_id,hold_reason_code) WHERE active DO UPDATE SET active=EXCLUDED.active

WITH RECURSIVE visible_scope(organization_unit_id,include_descendants) AS (SELECT scope_target_id,include_descendants FROM seal.user_scope WHERE admin_user_id=#{actorId} AND scope_type='ORGANIZATION' AND active=TRUE UNION SELECT c.organization_unit_id,TRUE FROM seal.organization_unit c JOIN visible_scope p ON c.parent_id=p.organization_unit_id WHERE p.include_descendants=TRUE), previous AS (UPDATE seal.retention_anchor_event a SET active=FALSE WHERE a.consent_request_id=#{request} AND a.anchor_type=#{type} AND a.active AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM seal.consent_request r JOIN visible_scope s USING(organization_unit_id) WHERE r.consent_request_id=a.consent_request_id) RETURNING a.retention_anchor_event_id) INSERT INTO seal.retention_anchor_event(retention_anchor_event_id,consent_request_id,anchor_type,anchor_date,supersedes_event_id,active,recorded_by,recorded_at) SELECT #{id},r.consent_request_id,#{type},#{anchorDate},(SELECT retention_anchor_event_id FROM previous LIMIT 1),TRUE,#{actorId},#{now} FROM seal.consent_request r JOIN visible_scope s USING(organization_unit_id) WHERE r.consent_request_id=#{request}

WITH RECURSIVE visible_scope(organization_unit_id,include_descendants) AS (SELECT scope_target_id,include_descendants FROM seal.user_scope WHERE admin_user_id=#{actorId} AND scope_type='ORGANIZATION' AND active=TRUE UNION SELECT c.organization_unit_id,TRUE FROM seal.organization_unit c JOIN visible_scope p ON c.parent_id=p.organization_unit_id WHERE p.include_descendants=TRUE) INSERT INTO seal.legal_hold(legal_hold_id,consent_request_id,hold_reason_code,reason_text,expires_on,active,held_by,held_at) SELECT #{id},r.consent_request_id,#{reasonCode},#{reasonText},#{expiresOn,jdbcType=DATE},TRUE,#{actorId},#{now} FROM seal.consent_request r JOIN visible_scope s USING(organization_unit_id) WHERE r.consent_request_id=#{request} ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: WITH RECURSIVE visible_scope(organization_unit_id,include_descendants) AS (SELECT scope_target_id,include_descendants FROM seal.user_scope WHERE admin_user_id=#{actorId} AND scope_type='ORGANIZATION' AND active=TRUE UNION SELECT c.organization_unit_id,TRUE FROM seal.organization_unit c JOIN visible_scope p ON c.parent_id=p.organization_unit_id WHERE p.include_descendants=TRUE) UPDATE seal.legal_hold h SET active=FALSE,released_by=#{actorId},released_at=#{now} FROM seal.consent_request r JOIN visible_scope s USING(organization_unit_id) WHERE h.legal_hold_id=#{id} AND h.active AND r.consent_request_id=h.consent_request_id
mapper.select: SELECT h.legal_hold_id id,h.consent_request_id,h.hold_reason_code reason_code,h.expires_on,h.held_by,h.held_at FROM seal.legal_hold h JOIN seal.consent_request r USING(consent_request_id) JOIN visible_scope s USING(organization_unit_id) WHERE h.active ORDER BY h.held_at DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE seal.retention_job SET job_status=#{to},idempotency_key=COALESCE(#{key,jdbcType=OTHER},idempotency_key),requested_by=CASE WHEN #{to}='PENDING_APPROVAL' THEN #{actor} ELSE requested_by END,requested_at=CASE WHEN #{to}='PENDING_APPROVAL' THEN #{now} ELSE requested_at END,approved_by=CASE WHEN #{to}='APPROVED' THEN #{actor} ELSE approved_by END,approved_at=CASE WHEN #{to}='APPROVED' THEN #{now} ELSE approved_at END,executed_by=CASE WHEN #{to}='EXECUTING' THEN #{actor} ELSE executed_by END,executed_at=CASE WHEN #{to}='EXECUTED' THEN #{now} ELSE executed_at END,confirmed_by=CASE WHEN #{to}='CONFIRMED' THEN #{actor} ELSE confirmed_by END,confirmed_at=CASE WHEN #{to}='CONFIRMED' THEN #{now} ELSE confirmed_at END,destroyed_mail_count=#{result.mailCount},destroyed_file_count=#{result.fileCount},destroyed_session_count=#{result.sessionCount},destroyed_rights_count=#{result.rightsCount},recipient_pii_destroyed=#{result.recipientPiiDestroyed},row_version=row_version+1 WHERE retention_job_id=#{id} AND job_status=#{from} AND row_version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT relative_path FROM seal.evidence_package WHERE consent_request_id=#{request} AND generation_status='FINALIZED'
mapper.update: UPDATE seal.mail_outbox SET recipient_email_ciphertext=NULL,html_ciphertext=NULL,encryption_key_id=NULL,mail_status='DESTROYED',updated_at=#{now},version_no=version_no+1 WHERE consent_request_id=#{request} AND mail_status<>'DESTROYED'

UPDATE seal.evidence_package SET generation_status='DESTROYED',destroyed_at=#{now},relative_path=NULL,manifest_hmac=NULL,hmac_key_id=NULL,row_version=row_version+1 WHERE consent_request_id=#{request} AND generation_status='FINALIZED'
UPDATE seal.public_consent_session SET flow_hmac=NULL,flow_destroyed_at=#{now} WHERE consent_request_id=#{request} AND session_status IN('COMPLETED','EXPIRED') AND flow_hmac IS NOT NULL

UPDATE seal.rights_request rr SET detail_ciphertext=NULL,verification_note_ciphertext=NULL,result_note_ciphertext=NULL,encryption_key_id=NULL,verification_note_key_id=NULL,result_note_key_id=NULL,personal_data_destroyed_at=#{now},row_version=row_version+1 WHERE rr.personal_data_destroyed_at IS NULL AND ((rr.consent_request_id=#{request} AND rr.request_status IN('COMPLETED','CANCELLED')) OR rr.rights_request_id=(SELECT source_rights_request_id FROM seal.retention_job WHERE retention_job_id=#{job}))

UPDATE seal.recipient rec SET recipient_name_ciphertext=NULL,recipient_email_ciphertext=NULL,encryption_key_id=NULL,email_lookup_hmac=NULL,recipient_status='DESTROYED',updated_at=#{now},version_no=version_no+1 WHERE rec.recipient_id=#{recipient} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM seal.consent_request other WHERE other.recipient_id=rec.recipient_id AND other.consent_request_id<>#{request} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM seal.retention_job j WHERE j.consent_request_id=other.consent_request_id AND j.job_status='CONFIRMED'))
